entities.summary: United Kingdom is a sovereign nation in Northern Europe, Europe. Its capital is London. Official languages include English. Government: Unitary parliamentary constitutional monarchy. Population: approximately 68.3 million. Area: 242,495 km². Comprehensive index for United Kingdom covering Celtic Britons, Roman Britain (43-410 CE), Anglo-Saxon Heptarchy, Viking Danelaw, Norman Conquest 1066, Plantagenet dynasty, Magna Carta 1215, Hundred Years War, Wars of the Roses, Tudor dynasty (Henry VIII Reformation/Church of England, Elizabeth I Spanish Armada 1588), Stuart period (Union of Crowns 1603, English Civil War 1642-51/Cromwell, Glorious Revolution 1688), Acts of Union 1707 (Great Britain), British Empire (largest in history, 'sun never sets', 1/4 world population, decolonization), Industrial Revolution (first industrialized nation), Napoleonic Wars (Trafalgar 1805/Wellington Waterloo 1815), Victorian era (1837-1901, imperial zenith), WWI (1M dead), WWII (Battle of Britain/Blitz, Churchill), welfare state (NHS 1948), Suez Crisis 1956 (end of empire), Troubles (Northern Ireland 1968-98), Thatcher era (1979-90), devolution (Scotland/Wales/NI 1990s), Good Friday Agreement 1998, Iraq War 2003, Brexit referendum 2016 (Leave 51.9%)/exit EU Jan 31 2020, COVID, cost-of-living crisis.
